reuse.why: Changes the existing getExpectedAmount helper that forecast, schedule actions, previews and getScheduledAmount already use, and routes the template's remaining hand copy through it.

duplication.why: Removes the last inline midpoint copy in schedule-template.ts and adds no new copies.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts, the shared definition of a schedule's expected amount.

scope.why: Only the rule, the template call site, a test and a release note change.

maintainability.why: Every consumer now gets the rule from one function, so later rule changes are one edit.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The previously bypassing template site now calls getExpectedAmount.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic remains or is introduced.

one_place.where: getExpectedAmount in shared/schedules.ts, used by forecast-schedules.ts, schedules/app.ts (two sites), computeSchedulePreviewTransactions, getScheduledAmount (client consumers) and now schedule-template.ts.
